hook: Water Board races to add *40 MGD* Godavari water by Nov 15
hook_b: Water Board races to add *40 MGD* Godavari water by Nov 15
tldr: HMWSSB is speeding up Godavari pipeline interconnection works at Ghanpur, with crews working round the clock.

beats.what: MD K Ashok Reddy ordered three eight-hour shifts, floodlights for night work and extra labour teams.
beats.why: Water availability from the Singur-Manjeera sources is declining because of El Nino conditions.
beats.care: Areas that depend on Singur-Manjeera water are to get Godavari supply prioritised.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: Road-crossing work was ordered to start so pipes can be laid within two to three days.

cards.q: Has your area's water supply dropped this month?

qs: How do residents know whether their area is Singur-Manjeera fed?

facts.t: Crews ordered to work *3 eight-hour shifts* with separate teams for each.

learn.t: MGD = million gallons per day, the unit used for city water supply.

watch: Whether the Ghanpur interconnection is finished by the Nov 15 deadline.

fact: Hyderabad could get *40 million gallons a day* more Godavari water by Nov 15.
twist: The push comes because Singur-Manjeera supply is falling under El Nino conditions.
